reason: CR 508.7 attack-target reselection: ability trees gain Effect::ReselectAttackTarget and EffectKind::ReselectAttackTarget; WaitingFor::EntryAttackTargetChoice gains a defaulted purpose (AttackTargetChoicePurpose EnterAttacking|Reselect); the resolved-rules journal's ResolvedCombatMembershipEdit gains a Reselect edit. Older full-game/P2P peers cannot decode the new effect tag or journal edit and would answer a Reselect prompt as an entering creature, seating a duplicate attacker. CombatState gains removed_attacker_defenders: the defending player each attacker had when removed from combat, per exact incarnation (CR 508.5 last clause; read by the defending-player authority). The DefendingPlayer leaf of PlayerScope, ControllerRef and TargetFilter gains a defaulted reading (AttackRelationReading Current|AsDeclared): Current is the live CR 508.5 defending player and keeps the old encoding; AsDeclared is the player a triggering attack declared (CR 508.7a), which attack-trigger 'that player' conditions, target controllers, attacking-defender filters, token attack destinations, the attack-enchanted-player recipient and Dethrone serialize; older peers cannot decode the AsDeclared reading.
